name: Pikachu-Sinnoh (shiny)
normal_excluded_reason: Normal Sinnoh keeps its already approved compact-r5 art and folder; this separate variant record only publishes newly drawn shiny poses.
prompt: Mechanically repack genuine native/built-in drawn poses. Binary alpha before tight crop; register new prone strip by one uniform factor for both frames, preserving every unrelated crop and pixel. No painting, standing-pose warping or camera rotation. Exact recipe and source hashes included.
shiny_prompt: Mechanically repack genuine native/built-in drawn poses. Binary alpha before tight crop; register new prone strip by one uniform factor for both frames, preserving every unrelated crop and pixel. No painting, standing-pose warping or camera rotation. Exact recipe and source hashes included.

review.scope: Independent visual review, normal and shiny separately; exact PNG hashes checked
